answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 156005 Country: India Title: Dairy milk products including cadbury Question: Assalamualaikum ..i want to ask whether it is permissible to use dairy milk products including cadbury choclate products .. if not plz suggest which other companies choclates and choclate products i can use.. Answer ID: 156005 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 176/143/D=2/1439) Any eatable or drinkable thing cannot be termed haram until it is not confirmed or known that its ingredient contains any haram and impure thing. We do not have any knowledge about Cadbury chocolate. The same is the rule of the chocolates of other companies. الأصل في الأشياء الإباحة (قواعد الفقه) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
